leaves.name: rationalHeckeSpan
leaves.doc: For k >= 2, S_k(Gamma_1(N)) is spanned over C by cusp forms g such that g and T_p g (Tau Ceti's double coset operator Gamma_1(N) diag(1,p) Gamma_1(N)) have rational q-expansions for every prime p not dividing N. Consequence of: S_k(Gamma_1(N)) has a basis in S_k(Gamma_1(N), Z), and S_k(Gamma_1(N), Z) is stable under the T_n (Shimura 1971 Thm 3.52 with section 3.5; Diamond-Im 1995 sections 12.3-12.4; Diamond-Shurman section 6.5 for k = 2; locators UNVERIFIED). Follows in Lean from gamma1IntegralSpan with heckePrimeIntegralToRational or diamondIntegralToRational (coeff-rational).
